title: The Funny Puppy
lines: Meg has a funny little puppy.
The puppy digs a big pit by the pond.
It digs up a penny in the mud.
The puppy will not let go of it.
Meg tugs at it, but the puppy runs off.
Then Meg holds up the puppy's red ball.
The puppy drops the penny and grabs the ball.
Then Meg spots a sad lady on the path.
The lady lost a penny in the grass.
A happy baby sits next to the lady.
Meg hands the penny back, and the baby claps.

questions.ask: What did the puppy dig up by the pond?
questions.listenFor: A penny, out of the mud. Stated in the story - point them back to the line.

questions.ask: How did Meg get the penny away from the puppy?
questions.listenFor: She held up the puppy's red ball, and the puppy dropped the penny. If they say "she tugged it," ask "did that work?"

questions.ask: Do you think the lady was glad to get the penny back? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for the reason - she was sad before, or the baby clapped.
